TARGET_LANG = 'zh-Hans'; // 目标语言
// 需要移除的选择器
var remove_selector = [
    'script',
    'div.btn-row.-page-actions',
    'main aside'
];

    // 1. 获取 client-secret
    authUrl = "https://edge.microsoft.com/translate/auth";
    // 调用 java.ajax 获取 client-secret
    clientSecret = java.ajax(authUrl);
    
    // 将 clientSecret 转换为字符串（解决 ConsString 问题）
    if (typeof clientSecret === "object" && clientSecret.toString) {
        clientSecret = clientSecret.toString();
    }
    java.put("AUTH",clientSecret)
    html = result
    java.put("HTML",html)
    //java.log("Auth: " + clientSecret);
}
getAUTHkey()

Jsoup = org.jsoup.Jsoup

clientSecret = java.get("AUTH")
//html = java.get("HTML")
//java.log("nodes: " + nodes)
//java.log("html:" + java.get("HTML"))

var doc = Jsoup.parse(html);

// 遍历选择器并移除匹配的元素
remove_selector.forEach(function(css) {
    var elements = doc.select(css); // 选择匹配的元素
    elements.forEach(function(element) {
        element.remove(); // 移除单个元素
        //java.log("Removed element with selector: " + css); // 记录日志
    });
});

var textNodes = [];
doc.select("*").forEach(function(element) {
    element.textNodes().forEach(function(textNode) {
        if (textNode.text().trim().length() > 0) {
            textNodes.push({
                node: textNode,
                original: textNode.text()
            });
        }
    });
});

// 准备翻译请求
function chunkArray(array, chunkSize) {
    var result = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < array.length; i += chunkSize) {
        result.push(array.slice(i, i + chunkSize));
    }
    return result;
}

var chunkSize = 50000; // 每批字符数限制
var totalChars = 0;
var currentChunk = [];
var chunks = [];

textNodes.forEach(function(t) {
    var textLength = t.original.length();
    if (totalChars + textLength > chunkSize) {
        chunks.push(currentChunk);
        currentChunk = [];
        totalChars = 0;
    }
    currentChunk.push(t);
    totalChars += textLength;
});

if (currentChunk.length > 0) {
    chunks.push(currentChunk);
}

var allTranslated = [];

chunks.forEach(function(chunk) {
    var payload = chunk.map(function(t) {
        return t.original;
    });
    body = JSON.stringify(payload);
    headers = {
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + clientSecret, // 使用 client-secret 作为授权令牌
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    };
    headers = JSON.stringify({"headers": headers, "method": "post", "body": body});
    endpoint = `https://edge.microsoft.com/translate/translatetext?to=${TARGET_LANG}`;

    response = java.ajax(endpoint + "," + headers);
    //java.log(endpoint + "," + headers);
    var translated = JSON.parse(response);
    allTranslated = allTranslated.concat(translated);
});

// 替换文本内容
allTranslated.forEach((result, index) => {
    const translatedText = result.translations[0].text;
    textNodes[index].node.text(translatedText);
});

result = doc.html();
result
</js>
